q: Which deficit shows the total borrowing needs of the government?
x: Fiscal deficit = total expenditure minus total receipts other than borrowing. It equals how much the government must borrow.

q: Fiscal deficit minus interest payments is called…
x: Primary deficit removes interest on old loans, so it shows the borrowing for this year's spending alone.

q: The Monetary Policy Committee of the RBI has how many members, and who heads it?
x: Six members: three from the RBI and three appointed by the government. The RBI Governor chairs it and has a casting vote.

q: What is the RBI's inflation target?
x: 4% CPI inflation, with a tolerance band of 2% to 6%.

q: Which price index does the RBI use for its inflation target?
x: Since 2014–16 the RBI targets headline CPI (combined) inflation.
The one-rupee note is issued by the Ministry of Finance and signed by the Finance Secretary. All other notes are issued by the RBI.

q: GST started on ___, and the GST Council is under Article ___.
x: GST came on 1 July 2017 through the 101st Amendment. Article 279A sets up the GST Council; 246A gives the power to make GST laws.

q: Which Five Year Plan was based on the Mahalanobis model?
x: The Second Plan (1956–61) followed P.C. Mahalanobis and stressed heavy industry. The First Plan used the Harrod–Domar model.

q: Which was the last Five Year Plan?
x: The 12th Plan ended in 2017. NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission in 2015.

q: Who is the chairperson of NITI Aayog?
x: The Prime Minister chairs NITI Aayog. The Vice-Chairperson and CEO run it day to day.

q: Which of these is NOT a dimension of the Multidimensional Poverty Index?
x: The MPI uses three dimensions: health, education and standard of living. It does not use income.

q: Which committee is linked to banking sector reforms?
x: The Narasimham Committees (1991 and 1998) recommended banking reforms. Tendulkar and Rangarajan worked on poverty lines; Kelkar on taxes.

o: More people work than needed, so removing some does not reduce output
People are out of work only in some seasons
People lose jobs because of new technology
People change jobs and are briefly without work
x: Disguised unemployment is common in farming: the extra workers add nothing to output. Seasonal, technological and frictional unemployment are the other options.

q: What is the minimum amount for an RTGS transfer?
x: RTGS needs at least ₹2 lakh and has no upper limit. NEFT has no minimum.

q: Which body regulates pensions in India?
x: The Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority runs the NPS. IRDAI regulates insurance; SEBI regulates markets.
